name: Close a member account with a zero balance
description:
Look up the member by member number and open their profile to confirm the account with the given account_no is present and its balance is $0.00. There is no on-page link to close a specific account, so navigate directly to the close-account screen for this member and this account_no (the URL follows the pattern /member/{member_id}/accounts/{account_no}/close). Confirm the account's balance shown there is $0.00, then click Close Account. Read back the account number shown on the resulting confirmation screen.

Returns: closed_account_no — The account number confirmed as closed.. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found, nonzero_balance.
